race.name: Kindred
entries: As a Kindred, your character has the following traits:

entries.name: Age
entries: Your lifespan is influenced by your mortal lineage; if your mortal lineage dictates an age, use that expectancy. Otherwise, your spiritual lifespan extends up to 1,000 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Your alignment is often shaped by your mortal upbringing, but kindred are by nature neutral, walking the boundary between life and death.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking speed is 30 feet, and you have a climbing speed equal to your walking speed.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: Aided by the senses of the Wolf, you can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can discern colors in dim light.

entries.name: Death Mark
entries: At the start of combat, you can mark a target creature within 60 feet. The marked target takes 1 extra damage from each of your weapon attacks. When a marked target dies, you gain a death mark counter. For every 4 death marks you accumulate during a combat, your weapon attacks gain an extra 5 feet of range and deal 1 additional damage to marked targets. This counter resets when combat ends.

entries.name: Wolf
entries: The Wolf is your eternal guardian spirit, advising you and awakening in battle. The Wolf speaks Sylvan. Once per turn, you can command the Wolf to strike a marked target within 20 feet of you as a free action, dealing {@damage 1d4} + your Dexterity modifier in piercing damage. After the Wolf has downed 4 enemies, you regain hit points equal to {@dice 1d8} + your Constitution modifier.

entries.name: Keen Senses
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Perception} skill.

entries.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: You have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}, and magic can't put you to sleep.

entries.name: Lamb's Respite
entries: When you are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum of once), regaining expended uses after a long rest.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common, Sylvan, and one extra language of your choice.

entries.name: Kindred
entries: Death is an inevitable force in the multiverse, commonly depicted as a solitary reaper with a scythe. But the true reapers of souls are the Kindred—a dual entity of Lamb and Wolf who hunt together. Bound as two halves of a single soul, Lamb grants peaceful departure with her arrows to those who accept their fate, while Wolf relentlessly runs down those who flee from their end.
